raw.name: Senior Product Analyst - Warsaw
raw.About the role:
• Product Performance Leadership: Help drive product management efforts by defining key customer metrics, identifying strategic opportunities, and leading the company in achieving its performance goals.
  • Customer Analytics Platform Ownership: Own and optimize all customer-facing analytics tools, ensuring they empower data-driven decisions across the client platform.
  • Proactive Business Insight Generation: Conduct continuous, in-depth analysis to uncover emerging business trends and opportunities, and implement A/B testing to optimize performance.
  • Cross-functional strategic Partnership: Collaborate closely with and provide strategic support to diverse stakeholders, delivering data-backed recommendations to inform key decision-making.
  • Data-Driven Reporting and Communication: Develop and deliver clear, concise reports and presentations that translate complex data into actionable insights for executive leadership and relevant teams.
  • Proactive Problem Solving and Innovation: Identify and address potential challenges proactively, and champion innovative approaches to enhance data analysis and product strategies.
  • Continuous Improvement and Optimization: Focus on continuous improvement, identify areas for optimization, and implement strategies to enhance product performance and customer experience.

This role will report to the Senior Product Manager.
